name: near_ball plan_v3: where the pipeline loses the player on the ball
owner request: Oui lance (find, on CPU, which pipeline step loses the actor)
why: plan_v2 (exploratory part): the raw detector finds the actor on 0.867 of the actions, the pipeline's output on 0.767; on 11.3% of the actions the raw detector has the actor and the output does not.
seen before this plan: Row counts of one unit's stage files (st2_117093_1st_f000000): players 27,570 in tracks.parquet, 26,659 after the outline, 18,715 in tracks_merged; team labels in tracks_grass: other 14,285, team_A 8,243, team_B 4,076, NaN 55. No actor-level result of any stage was looked at.
data: The 2,255 actions of variants.parquet (actions.parquet x the clips' labels, 223 units, 9 matches, M1 left out), each at its even frame. The pipeline's cached stages in the unit's run directory (the folder metric_v3s_link.parquet links to).

stages (players only).S0 raw: plan_v2's V0 detections (yolov8s, imgsz 4096, conf >= 0.20, NMS IoU 0.70), feet inside the outline (margin 0), from the kernel veo-nearball-det
stages (players only).S1 tracker: tracks.parquet (run_detection: detector + tracker), feet inside the outline with the run's margin (pitch.json margin_px)
stages (players only).S2 teams: tracks_grass.parquet (the outline cut, team labels, grass fractions)
stages (players only).S3 assigned: S2 without unassigned team labels (player_filter.filter_players rule 1 alone)
stages (players only).S4 roster cap: player_filter.filter_players(S2): rule 1, then at most 11 per frame per team label, longest tracks first
stages (players only).S5 output: metric_v3s_link.parquet (the rows near_ball.py scored: track re-joining, ball selection, pitch metres)

measure (per stage, same as score_det.py: actor detected (a detection matched to the actor by feet, eval_soccertrack_v2.match_feet, 43 px) / taken (a detection within 43 px matched to someone else) / missed; the control (other outfield players on the same frames detected); detections per frame.
reported: the share of actions with the actor detected at each stage
among actions detected at S0 and not at S5: the first stage where the actor is lost (share of all actions)
for actions lost at S4: the team label of the actor's detection at S3 and its track's length rank among its frame's same-label detections
the same per match, and the control's loss per stage (is the loss specific to the actor?)
reading rule: Diagnostic, no pass bar. A stage is named the main loss if it accounts for at least half of the 11.3 points; any fix it suggests goes to a new registered plan scored end to end.
unseal: M7 / M9 opened clips through src/unseal.py, logged.
